thread:
Alex W: Quick sync — opening a tiny cross-PR to canonicalize glossary IDs and rotate SDK snippets to param-case.

Maria G: Thanks — which glossary entries are we changing?

Alex W: Minimal set to start: "voiceTone" -> "voice-tone", "modelConfig" -> "model-config". Also consolidating IDs for embeddings to namespace format, e.g., `redwood/embedding/v1`.

Devon H: Are these breaking changes for existing SDK users?

Alex W: Should be non-breaking if we keep alias mapping for 2 weeks. Plan: add new canonical IDs, update docs and SDK examples, then add deprecation note. Rollout timeline in PR description.

Samir K: Pinged infra to update the autocomplete on console? If docs change, console should prefer canonical IDs.

Alex W: Yes — @Samir K please coordinate console fallback. I'll put a checklist in the PR.

docs-ci-bot: Linkcheck failed on /docs/sdk/python/snippets.md: broken link https://old.example.com/snippet -> 404

Jen (Docs): I'll fix that link in a separate patch. Also running a quick grep for param-case snippets.

Maria G: For the SDK snippets, can we update both JS and Python at once? PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 (glossary edits), https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4127 (sdk-snippets).

Alex W: Yes, target both. Quick example of migration pattern for snippets:

```
// old
client.generate({ modelConfig: { model: "rwd-xl", temperature: 0.1 } })

# new
client.generate({ model-config: { model: "rwd-xl", temperature: 0.1 } })
```

Devon H: Hmm we should keep both keys in the parser so old code doesn't break. Add temporary alias support in runtime.

Alex W: Agreed. Action items:
- Alex: open PR 4123 and 4127 and add checklist
- Maria: update JS snippets
- Jen: fix linkcheck and run docs linter
- Samir: console autocomplete fallbacks
- Devon: runtime alias support

Maria G: I'll take JS snippets, aim to push today. cc @Jen (Docs) for linter run.

Jen (Docs): I'll queue the linter and fix the link. Once CI green we can merge in sequence (glossary -> sdk -> console -> runtime).

Samir K: Noted. I'll prioritize console change after sdk PR merges, should be a quick toggle.

Alex W: Thanks all. If anyone hits users depending on old IDs, add a short FAQ line in the PR. I'll shepherd merges.

Jen (Docs): FYI I added a small note in PR 4123 about keeping alias mapping for 14 days and a rollout tag `docs:glossary-rotation`.

Devon H: I'll add runtime alias for both keys and set feature-flag off-by-default; enable during rollout.

Alex W: Great, close the loop here when PRs merged. :thumbsup:
